text:
kevin_sales: Quick q from AcmeBankthey want a 2-week POC with APAC-only processing for a subset of customers. Need: confirmed region pinning, APAC subprocessor list, BYOK options, and a short network diagram. Can we provide a single-page summary?

anya_presales: Yup. Clarify: do they need one tenant pinned to ap-northeast-1 or will they accept routing affinity? They insisted "no PII leaves region".

kevin_sales: Tenant pinning preferred. Also asked whether BYOK possible without Dedicated.

leo_engops: Tenant pinning -> compute + storage stay in chosen region. Control-plane telemetry still flows to hosted control plane unless they request Private. BYOK integration requires Dedicated/Private; otherwise we can provide KMS attestation and rotate keys on our side. For strict POC enforcement we can set deny_cross_region=true in routing policy.

maya_security: Note: monitoring/logs vendors may ingest cross-region by default. In APAC we use AWS (ap-northeast-1), Cloudflare edge, Datadog. We can reconfigure Datadog to regional ingestion endpoints for the POC; need 3-5 business days for full lock-down.

diane_legal: We will share a subprocessor list (vendor name, role, region) with redacted contact info. DPA amendments for subprocessors add ~10 business days. Also include a paragraph on what we classify as "processing" vs "control signals".

anya_presales: Draft bullets for customer: 1) Tenant pinning: compute & storage stay in ap-northeast-1; 2) Control plane: hosted by default; Private option available; 3) Subprocessors: attached list; 4) BYOK: available with Dedicated/Private; attestation otherwise; 5) Routing: deny_cross_region=true possible for POC but requires SOW for full enforcement; 6) Timeline: diagram + subproc list in 48h; full enforcement 3-5 business days + SOW.

ops-bot: Reminder: eng-ops oncall leo_engops for 72h.

kevin_sales: Great, I'll send that summary and ask for confirmation. Thanks everyone."
